title: Before You Escalate a Supply Risk

eligibility.statement: Motion helps because the reader needs to see an illustrative risk signal pass through the four ordered checks before it becomes a joint exception.
eligibility.reader_value: The animated signal makes the dependency between date reliability, customer exposure, recovery, and joint ownership easier to follow without changing the working method.

locked_elements: all exact text, questions, and field notes
Shetty's Desk marks and source labels
the complete approved Field Guide still
all gate geometry, rules, and arrows

semantic_regions.communication_job: Represent one illustrative risk signal without implying a real supplier or customer event.
Show that the changed date is only a signal until its reliability is checked.
Carry the illustrative signal to the separate customer need-by check.
Show that recovery is tested before it is treated as a promise.
Land on the joint KAM and Purchasing Manager decision only when the gap remains.

beats.communication_job: Show the complete Field Guide before any signal appears.
Pause at date reliability before allowing the signal to proceed.
Trace the signal to customer exposure and hold it at that decision boundary.
Move through the recovery check without implying that recovery works.
Land at the visible joint exception owner action.
Return to the complete motion-free reference for reading and saving.
